checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly one white leather sneaker is shown.
must.why: One white sneaker with leather and mesh panels.

must.item: The background is plain white, with no scenery or props.
must.why: Background is plain with no props but light grey gradient, not white.

must.item: The entire shoe is visible with space around it.
must.why: Whole shoe visible with margins, though the toe is fairly close to the right edge.

must.item: No promotional text, badges or graphic borders appear.
must.why: No promo text or borders; only tiny illegible logo marks on the shoe.

faults.what: Background is light grey rather than white
Tiny garbled pseudo-logo text on the tongue and midsole
Toe is close to the right edge, so margins are uneven

summary: A clean, realistic side-view white sneaker on a plain light-grey studio background; the background is grey rather than pure white and there are small garbled logo marks.
